study: A03E9 prospective fixed-F± CLASS three-state transfer-derived, R16-filtered, one-sigma LOS-wind conditional quasi-static exact-occupancy Eq20/33 phase and dphase/dln(a); NOT survey or full retarded Einstein-Vlasov forecast
registration_boundary: Registered after original E8/E8b/E8c static source results and after the independent mathematical fixed-200km/s analytic derivative diagnostic. BEFORE any new three-state CLASS execution or inspection of its transfer-derived wind results. Do not refit grid or cuts to outcomes.

fixed_numerical_grid.interpolation: linear interpolation on original CLASS transfer-k grid, no extrapolation; source occupation linear interpolation on frozen 4000q grid

velocity_definition.delta_rel: CLASS newtonian gauge d_ncdm[0](k,z)-d_cdm(k,z) separately in all three F states
velocity_definition.signed_spectrum: v_rel(k,z)=-c*H_CLASS(z)/k_Mpc * (d delta_rel/dz) * sqrt(A_s*(k_Mpc/0.05Mpc^-1)^(n_s-1)), same convention as wake_two_tracer_fisher.delta_v_kms except sign retained
velocity_definition.sigma3d: sqrt(integral up to original k_com=0.1h/Mpc of v_rel(k,z)^2 W_tophat(k R=16Mpc/h)^2 dlnk), original cumulative_trapz_logk convention
velocity_definition.one_sigma_los_condition: v_parallel(z)=+sigma3d(z)/sqrt(3), SAME +1 normalized Gaussian LOS rank at all z and source states, NOT observed halo wind, not stochastic realization or Gaussian ensemble
velocity_definition.independent_checks: Original base.delta_v_kms absolute per k agrees with signed velocity magnitude at same step and original velocity_summary filtered cumulative; half-step velocity derivative reported; no tuning if checks fail
velocity_definition.velocity_variation_source: F± modify their own CLASS relative neutrino-CDM transfers, not frozen FD velocity

alpha_and_derivative.formula: alpha_s(k_com,z)=2 G m_nu^4 a(z)^2 v_parallel_s(z) f_eff_s(q_res)/(hbar^3 k_com^2), q_res=m_nu |v_parallel_s|/(c*Tnu0*(1+z)), f_eff_s(q)=fFD_exact(q)*[F_s_interp(q)/F0_interp(q)]; original E8c exact-occupancy branch; k_phys=k_com/a
alpha_and_derivative.phase_source_split: compute total F± with own CLASS v_LOS and occupation, and counterfactual F± with FD v_LOS to isolate source-only vs wind-induced change. This is exact algebraic bookkeeping under common rank, not a causal assignment of nonlinear halo physics.
alpha_and_derivative.derivative: dalpha/dln a = -(1+z) [alpha(z+h)-alpha(z-h)]/(2h), two fixed z steps. d alpha/dt = H_phys_s(z) d alpha/dln a with state CLASS H converted to s^-1
alpha_and_derivative.single_redshift_center: z=0.95 with original [0.9,1.0) pilot only as mathematical midpoint not measured eBOSS z_eff
alpha_and_derivative.mu_convention: Exact FD occupation first Eq20 only; published mu approximation and its convention conflict remain unresolved

numerical_QA_only.meaning: 5% diagnostics are predeclared technical warnings, NOT a physical A03 error acceptance, and no case may be dropped or parameters retuned if they fail; output reports all failures.

output: Three separately computed CLASS source state arrays at all seven predeclared z, transfer-k and v_R16 filtered velocities, physical H(z)
3 state conditional phase alpha(z) plus FD-wind matched source-only counterfactual at all seven z, exact split of total vs source-only vs wind-induced delta
Numerical center d alpha/dln a and SI d alpha/dt using both ±0.01 and ±0.005 and half-step velocity-delta checks
Retain all transfer and QA failures in JSON; no survey xi/window/likelihood
